title: Consolidate helper / error / charcount into a responsive helper row for compact and multi-line inputs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: We need a single, accessible helper row component that can display helper text, validation errors, and character counts across single-line, multi-line, and inline input variants. The goal is to reduce inconsistencies in spacing, avoid layout shifts when validation appears, and centralize token usage for compact and standard density forms.
acceptance_criteria: Single helper-row component implemented as design token-driven pattern
No layout shift when toggling between helper text and error state for inputs and textareas
Character count appears right-aligned in helper row for LTR and left-aligned for RTL; respects reduced-motion and font-size scale
Design tokens for spacing, font-size, color, and focus outlines extracted and documented
Accessibility: error semantic announced by screen readers when it appears; helper row uses role/status and aria-live where appropriate
Unit visual QA across all supported themes (light/dark/high-contrast)
notes: Trade-offs discussed: 1) Using a reserved helper row height to avoid jumps vs using collapse animation with prefers-reduced-motion respected. We opted for reserved height for compact density to preserve rhythm in form-heavy pages. 2) Character count placement: decided to pair text-left helper with count right-aligned in same row to minimize vertical space.
comments: 2026-02-12 — Aisha Patel: Initial research completed. Collected examples from product pages (signup, settings, admin forms) showing inconsistent helper placement and 6 instances of layout shift when errors appear.
2026-02-18 — Marco Ruiz: Reviewed token proposals with engineering. Concern about increasing DOM complexity for lightweight inputs; asked to produce minimal DOM change approach.

2026-02-22 — Olivia Chen (Engineering): Prototype implemented using a single helper div with CSS grid; initial perf looks good. Flagged that textareas with auto-resize need JS hook to recalc reserved height.
2026-02-28 — Accessibility review (Maya Singh): Recommend aria-live="polite" for helper row and role="status" for error text. Also recommend contrast ratio check for error icon.
2026-03-03 — Design review: Approve visual spec with small tweak: increase charcount font-weight to 600 at compact density for legibility. Action: update tokens and notify SDK owners.
2026-03-05 — Marco Ruiz: Engineering to land feature branch and add storybook examples for TextField, TextArea, and InlineSelect. Added ENG-2911 as dependence for CSS token rollout.
